name: Micco MAC-145 / SP20
summary: Sleek all-metal two-seat low-wing with retractable main gear and a tailwheel, originally from Al Meyers and revived by the Micco company in 1997 as the SP20.

wings: Low cantilever wing with no struts
Main gear retracts into the wing
engines: Single flat-four or flat-six in a slim cowl
fuselage: Enclosed side-by-side two-seat cabin; SP20 has a sliding bubble canopy
Retractable main gear with a tailwheel

tellTales: Sleek low-wing two-seater with retractable main wheels and a tailwheel
Smooth enclosed cabin, sometimes with a sliding bubble canopy
Large fin on a slim metal fuselage

confusedWith.howToTell: The Swift has a long sloping canopy, a tall swept fin and a slender fuselage; the MAC-145 has a more upright cabin and a larger fin.
The Cadet is a prewar, lower-powered design with a rounder fuselage; the MAC-145 is a postwar all-metal retractable with a larger engine.
The Meyers 200 is the larger four-seat sibling with tricycle gear; the MAC-145 is a two-seater with a tailwheel.
